title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: The ROC curve plots the true positive rate against the false positive rate at various threshold settings. A point on the curve represents a specific threshold.

title: Interpreting the Point on the ROC Curve
text: The point marked with an 'X' on the ROC curve indicates a specific balance between the true positive rate and the false positive rate. Consider how close this point is to the top-left corner of the plot.
